description: This file defines an enum 'ExecAllowlistMatcher' with static methods to perform matching of executable paths against an allowlist, including pattern validation and normalization, using regex. It includes methods for matching individual entries as well as multiple resolutions.

methods.name: match
methods.description: Matches a single ExecAllowlistEntry against an optional ExecCommandResolution, returning the first matching entry or nil.

methods.name: matchAll
methods.description: Matches multiple ExecCommandResolutions against an allowlist of entries, returning all matches.

methods.name: matches
methods.description: Checks if a pattern matches a target string using regex after normalization.

methods.name: normalizeMatchTarget
methods.description: Replaces backslashes with slashes and lowercases the string for normalization.

methods.name: regex
methods.description: Converts a wildcard pattern to an NSRegularExpression object for matching.
